3:A GitHub Action that runs a durable [pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi) coding agent on issues and pull requests, triggered by comments. Each issue or PR is one long-running conversation: follow-up comments continue it, several teammates can talk to it at once, and its full history is stored in your repository as git commits on `refs/pi/threads/<number>`.
10:- 💾 State in git, no external storage: each step is a commit on `refs/pi/threads/<number>`, pushed at every turn and once more in an `if: always()` step
48:    # One run per issue/PR at a time (see "Durable threads" below).
53:      contents: write       # push code and refs/pi/threads/*
370:git fetch origin 'refs/pi/threads/42:refs/pi/threads/42'
371:git log --oneline refs/pi/threads/42            # one commit per saved step
372:git show refs/pi/threads/42:batch.json | jq .   # what the latest step stored
377:#### Durable threads
379:Every issue or PR is one pi conversation, stored with [pi-durable](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@earendil-works/pi-durable) as a chain of git commits on `refs/pi/threads/<number>` in your repository (a custom ref: it doesn't show up as a branch). The storage backend is in [`src/storage`](src/storage).
388:  git fetch origin 'refs/pi/threads/*:refs/pi/threads/*'
389:  git log --oneline refs/pi/threads/42          # one commit per stored step
390:  git show refs/pi/threads/42:batch.json | jq   # the newest step's records
394:- **Pruning**: `git gc` won't shrink a thread (its history is reachable). Delete a finished thread with `git push origin :refs/pi/threads/42`.
